scope: Independent source-free contributor on existing Yggdrasil PR #1327; Amalgam PR #1278 alone owns canonical cumulative model and integration; original first-use issue #426 not authorized
question: Can a non-privileged confidence-locked write-admission rule protect earlier A slot readouts through changed B and improve prospective causal outcome forecasts; isolate write changes from a readout-only posterior mix with an exact 2×2 factorial.

world.private_truth: For each world, best arm = initial private role in A and return A, opposite role in B, Bernoulli 0.8 best and 0.2 otherwise; exogenous noise from existing TGAP21 SHA256 private domain. No hidden role, first/second switch, private coin or all-world teacher supplied to any candidate or matched ordinary control.
world.public: ONE address, step index and fixed action t%2, one witnessed binary outcome per step. Per-world public episode reset allowed, no hidden-world-specific learned lookup.

protected_writer.name: GuardedTwoSlot
protected_writer.base: Cloned research-only TGAP21 TwoSlotMemory: exact same public predictions, anomaly detector and two fixed Beta count slots; original native GF(2) source never altered
protected_writer.seal_rule: After every observed outcome, if slot0 not yet sealed AND slot0 total trials>=8 AND absolute Beta(1,1) posterior mean difference between binary actions >=0.2, snapshot slot0 counts and mark sealed. No phase/hidden truth/target label access.
protected_writer.write_rule: For subsequent witnessed actions, call original TGAP21 stage exactly once, then if slot0 was sealed before that step overwrite only slot0 numerical counts with its original sealed snapshot; all other cursor and original anomaly state transitions remain. Track count of suppressed writes and original witnessed total; preserve exactly two slots and one immutable A snapshot. This deliberately tests irreversible protective admission, not an inference that a changed law has been detected.
protected_writer.replay: Source type gate, exact ordered step; canonical JSON, SHA256 digest and sealed snapshot validate across independent restore. Accumulated factual action count equals sum of stored counts + suppressed writes.
protected_writer.no_fit: Identical guarded writer without 72 FIT observations, cold cloned at start of each held world.

reader.gate: Unmodified TGAP21 active-slot Beta prediction, no additional state
reader.soft: Extra scalar p(slot1) with prior .5, same fixed hazard 1/16 and pre-update Bayes likelihood mixing of two slot forecasts as KNOW22; update this scalar only from witnessed reward without affecting writer. No private phase/switch.
reader.strict_separation: At every held step, original_gate and original_soft must have byte-for-byte identical original writer checkpoints; guarded_gate and guarded_soft must have byte-for-byte identical guarded checkpoints. Original and guarded writers may differ only due to declared admission rule, not input/action tape.

controls: model-informed FIT-trained HMM with known .8/.2 likelihood and hazard1/16 (extra structural prior, separately flagged)

metrics.primary: Held overall prequential Brier lower is better on exactly 640 common witnessed action outcomes per arm, each forecast made before result.
secondary: Return-only Brier on exactly 234 witnessed outcomes per arm
FIT old A slot0 forecasts before B, after B and after A recurrence for both writers, exact changed counts
FIT versus no-FIT transfer and same-writer readout delta
Factorial decomposition: protected-gate minus original-gate, protected-soft minus original-soft, and readout delta with each writer
Byte-exact checkpoint/cold restore, source forgery and replay negatives, runtime and memory bytes; no whole-process cost gain claim

hypotheses.H1: Guarded writer preserves two slot0 action forecasts exactly after FIT B (zero old A drift), original writer may drift
hypotheses.H2: Guarded_gate_fit return Brier beats original_gate_fit by >=0.0100
hypotheses.H3: Guarded_soft_fit return Brier beats original_soft_fit by >=0.0100
hypotheses.H4: Guarded_soft_fit overall held Brier is <= fully FIT-trained rolling-8 Beta
hypotheses.decision: Report each independently; write-recovery DEV_SUPPORTED only if H1,H2,H3,H4 ALL true. MIXED if any true; NO_GO otherwise. No tuning seeds, thresholds or switches based on outcome.

engineering: Predeclared exact tests, 72 FIT +640 per arm, public source/cold custody, writer identical across readout-only arms, Linux and Windows focused and mandatory full final, G29 atlas seal, previous real TRAIN image compatibility. Engineering tests may pass while hypothesis fails.
science: Synthetic DEV ONLY; SCIENTIFIC_NO_GO without owner admission of genuinely unfamiliar original causal source, equal-prior Bayes/symbolic/conventional strongest-control benefit, independent reproduction, preservation of functional old→new→old at same address and whole-process efficiency.
prohibitions: No replay prior TGAP21/TGAP22/KNOW22 held seeds; no protected first use issue426; no new PR/controller or scheduler; no model-owner runner dispatch; no paid API; no merge, no accepted main or original NativeContextAccumulator mutation.
